messages:
sarah-cs: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting promo codes applied but no free credits granted since ~06:00 PT. Seeing a pattern: campaign shows max_redemptions = 0 in the API response.

alex-support: Can you drop a couple of ticket IDs? I can triage and escalate billing if needed.

sarah-cs: Tickets: #2321, #2322, #2327, #2330, #2334, #2338. All same error when trying to apply code. Customers hit checkout, code accepted visually, but credit balance unchanged.

james-billing: Pulled logs for one of the requests — billing API returns 400 with this body when trying to create grant:

```
{"error":"redemption_limit_exhausted","campaign_id":"c_7f8a","max_redemptions":0}
```

That 0 is suspicious. Campaign UI shouldn't allow 0.

mina-eng: I can repro locally with the admin UI. Steps:
1) Create campaign A with code "SPRING_A" start 2026-03-01 end 2026-03-31 max_redemptions 100
2) Create campaign B with code "SPRING_B" start 2026-03-15 end 2026-04-15 but leave max_redemptions blank in the UI (we expect null -> unlimited)
3) In the campaigns list quickly toggle active flags so they overlap
4) Apply code "SPRING_B" in checkout -> frontend sends campaign_id of campaign B but payload for `max_redemptions` is `0` (looks like missing->0 conversion at the API boundary)

Repro note: happens only when two campaigns overlap and the newer one is created via UI toggle while the older is still active. Likely a form-state bug where empty numeric field becomes 0 on submit.

alex-support: Oof. That explains the unexpected 0. Any quick mitigation? Customers are blocked.

sarah-cs: For immediate mitigation I manually patched the active campaign max_redemptions to 1000 for the affected campaign ids (c_7f8a, c_9d3b). Credited affected customers for tickets listed. Documented actions in the tickets.

james-billing: I'll schedule a small DB migration to convert stored 0 -> NULL for `max_redemptions` where `intent_unlimited = true` and campaign `status = active` and creation method = ui. But we should be careful — don't change explicit 0 if that's intended.

mina-eng: I'll add server-side validation to reject `max_redemptions = 0` when the client leaves the field blank. Also will fix the UI to send `null` instead of `0` for empty numeric inputs. Patch incoming.

deploy-bot: deploy started: patch/ui-null-max-redemptions by mina-eng (commit sha: a1b2c3d)
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded to staging in 00:03:12

james-billing: Migration plan: run read-only check first to list affected campaigns, then dry-run migration, then apply during low traffic window (03:00 PT). I'll post the migration diff in infra later today.

sarah-cs: Thanks everyone — please add a short incident note to the runbook and tag me when the migration is scheduled. I'll follow up with the affected customers tomorrow with a brief apology and summary. :pray:

mina-eng: Will do. PR for server-side validation opened: https://git.internal/redwood/campaigns/pull/458

alex-support: Copied mitigation steps into internal KB: "If customers report promo code applied but no credits: check campaign `max_redemptions` != 0, check overlapping campaigns, and apply manual credit if needed."

sarah-cs: Closing here once migration is done and QA verifies frontend no longer sends 0. Last update planned by 1768372945.

deploy-bot: migration job scheduled at 1768400000 (03:00 PT) by james-billing

james-billing: I'll update when migration completes.
